explanation: OSType in the top-level response chunk; selects the overall DAAP response message type, e.g., msrv for server-info response.

position: Every DAAP response body (content code mstt)
explanation: DAAP response status code present in every response; selects the success/error protocol outcome. The supplied DAAP excerpt does not enumerate the numeric values.

position: HTTP/1.1 response status line (RFC 9112 Section 3.1.2); semantics in RFC 9110 Section 15
explanation: Three-digit HTTP response status-code; the first digit selects the response class/outcome: informational, successful, redirection, client error, or server error.
